tasks.label: Environment: Run all first time recommended tasks
tasks.command: echo ✅ Successfully ran all first time recommended tasks

tasks.label: Environment: Run Doctor
tasks.command: mkdir -p logs && ./doctor.sh --verbose 2>&1 | tee >(sed 's/\x1B\[[0-9;]*[mK]//g' > logs/doctor-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S).log); exit ${PIPESTATUS[0]}

tasks.label: .NET: Restore Tools
tasks.command: dotnet tool restore

tasks.label: .NET: Install Profiler
tasks.command: dotnet tool install --global dotnet-trace; export PATH="$PATH:/home/ubuntu/.dotnet/tools"

tasks.label: Aseprite: Start
tasks.command: DIR="${workspaceFolder}/${input:asepriteProjectSelect}"; mkdir -p ~/.config/aseprite && touch ~/.config/aseprite/aseprite.ini && if grep -q 'current_folder' ~/.config/aseprite/aseprite.ini; then sed -i "s|^current_folder = .*|current_folder = $DIR|" ~/.config/aseprite/aseprite.ini; else echo -e "\n[file_selector]\ncurrent_folder = $DIR" >> ~/.config/aseprite/aseprite.ini; fi; cd "$DIR" && aseprite

tasks.label: Aseprite: Install Languages
tasks.command: FILE="${workspaceFolder}/aseprite-languages.txt"; if [ ! -f "$FILE" ]; then echo "Archivo $FILE no encontrado."; exit 1; fi; EXT_DIR="$HOME/.config/aseprite/extensions"; mkdir -p /tmp/ase_ext "$EXT_DIR"; while IFS='|' read -r enabled lang url || [ -n "$enabled" ]; do enabled=$(echo "$enabled" | tr -d '\r'); if [ "$enabled" = "true" ]; then url=$(echo "$url" | tr -d '\r'); lang=$(echo "$lang" | tr -d '\r'); echo "Downloading $lang extension..."; filename=$(basename "$url"); filepath="/tmp/ase_ext/$filename"; curl -# -L -o "$filepath" "$url"; target_folder="$EXT_DIR/$(basename "$filename" .aseprite-extension)"; rm -rf "$target_folder"; mkdir -p "$target_folder"; unzip -q "$filepath" -d "$target_folder"; fi; done < "$FILE"; rm -rf /tmp/ase_ext; echo "✅ Extensiones de lenguaje instaladas correctamente en el sistema."

tasks.label: Docker: View Logs (Nakama / DB)
tasks.command: docker logs -f --tail 100 ${input:serviceLogSelect}

tasks.label: Git: Clean Untracked & Ignored Files
tasks.command: git clean -fdx

tasks.label: Godot: Build
tasks.command: dotnet

tasks.label: Godot: Export Game
tasks.command: TARGET="${input:godotExportPlatform}"; mkdir -p builds/windows builds/linux builds/macos; if [ "$TARGET" = "All" ]; then godot --headless --export-release "Windows Desktop" && godot --headless --export-release "Linux" && godot --headless --export-release "macOS"; else godot --headless --export-release "$TARGET"; fi

tasks.label: Godot: Fix game input
tasks.command: sed -i 's|^run/window_placement/game_embed_mode = .*|run/window_placement/game_embed_mode = -1|' ~/.config/godot/editor_settings-4.7.tres && echo 'Godot game input fixed.'

tasks.label: Godot: Install Addons
tasks.command: godot --headless -s plug.gd install force debug; rm -rf .plugged

tasks.label: Godot: Install Export Templates
tasks.command: V="4.7.2"; DIR="${V}.stable.mono"; URL="https://github.com/godotengine/godot-builds/releases/download/${V}-stable/Godot_v${V}-stable_mono_export_templates.tpz"; echo "Downloading Godot ${V} Mono templates (this is a large file, wait a moment)..."; curl -L -o /tmp/tpl.zip "$URL" && echo "Extracting..." && unzip -q /tmp/tpl.zip -d /tmp/gtpl && mkdir -p ~/.local/share/godot/export_templates/$DIR && mv /tmp/gtpl/templates/* ~/.local/share/godot/export_templates/$DIR/ && rm -rf /tmp/tpl.zip /tmp/gtpl && echo "✅ Export templates installed successfully in ~/.local/share/godot/export_templates/$DIR/"

tasks.label: Godot: Start
tasks.command: P="${input:godotProjectSelect}"; godot -e ${P:+"--path" "$P"}

tasks.label: Godot: Start Profiler Server
tasks.command: mkdir -p .traces && NEXT=$(ls .traces/profile-*.nettrace 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/.*profile-\([0-9]*\)\.nettrace/\1/p' | sort -n | tail -1); NEXT=$(printf "%03d" $((10#${NEXT:-0} + 1))) && export PATH="$PATH:/home/ubuntu/.dotnet/tools" && rm -f /tmp/godot-diag && dotnet-trace collect --diagnostic-port /tmp/godot-diag --output ".traces/profile-${NEXT}.nettrace"

tasks.label: Godot: Stop all processes
tasks.command: ps -eo pid=,comm= | awk 'tolower($2) ~ /^godot/ {print $1}' | xargs -r kill -TERM

tasks.label: Godot: Stop Profiler & Convert Trace
tasks.command: export PATH="$PATH:/home/ubuntu/.dotnet/tools" && pkill -INT dotnet-trace && while pgrep dotnet-trace > /dev/null; do sleep 1; done && LATEST=$(ls -t .traces/profile-*.nettrace 2>/dev/null | head -n 1) && if [ -n "$LATEST" ]; then FMT="${input:traceFormatSelect}"; if [ "$FMT" != "none" ]; then dotnet-trace convert --format "$FMT" "$LATEST" && echo "Trace successfully converted to $FMT format!"; else echo "Trace kept in raw format: $LATEST!"; fi; fi

tasks.label: Nakama: Go Vendor
tasks.command: go mod vendor

tasks.label: Nakama: Build Plugin
tasks.command: cd backend && go build --trimpath --mod=vendor --buildmode=plugin -o ../nakama/modules/${input:pluginNameInput}.so && echo '✅ Plugin ${input:pluginNameInput}.so compiled and moved inside nakama/modules/'

tasks.label: Nakama: Build & Restart
tasks.command: echo ✅ Successfully built Go plugin and restarted Nakama server

tasks.label: Nakama: Restart Server
tasks.command: docker restart nakama

tasks.label: Nakama: Open Panel
tasks.command: code --command simpleBrowser.show http://localhost:7351/#/

tasks.label: Starship: Install in all terminals
tasks.command: touch ~/.bashrc && grep -qxF 'eval "$(starship init bash)"' ~/.bashrc || echo 'eval "$(starship init bash)"' >> ~/.bashrc; touch ~/.zshrc && grep -qxF 'eval "$(starship init zsh)"' ~/.zshrc || echo 'eval "$(starship init zsh)"' >> ~/.zshrc; mkdir -p ~/.config/powershell && touch ~/.config/powershell/Microsoft.PowerShell_profile.ps1 && grep -qxF 'Invoke-Expression (&starship init powershell)' ~/.config/powershell/Microsoft.PowerShell_profile.ps1 || echo 'Invoke-Expression (&starship init powershell)' >> ~/.config/powershell/Microsoft.PowerShell_profile.ps1; echo 'Starship configured in Bash, Zsh, and PowerShell'

tasks.label: Templates: Instantiate
tasks.command: find . -type f -name '*.template' | while read -r f; do dest="${f%.template}"; if [ ! -f "$dest" ]; then cp "$f" "$dest"; echo "Created: $dest"; fi; done
